title: Kenyan Beef Skillet
description: A hearty Kenyan-inspired beef skillet recipe, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove beef from skillet and set aside.
Add onion and garlic to skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add bell pepper and cook until tender, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add chili powder, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Return beef to skillet and stir to coat with spice mixture.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until beef is cooked through.
